title: Same Tokenizer, Better Tokens: Choosing Image Tokens by MAP Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.33261v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete visual tokens encode images for reconstruction and serve as training targets for autoregressive image generators. Vector-quantized tokenizers typically assign each encoder feature its nearest code independently. The decoder uses these codes jointly, so a sequence of individually nearest codes can reconstruct an image less faithfully than an alternative assignment. A local model of the reconstruction loss yields a closest-vector problem with a decoder-dependent target and metric. Reconstruction-only search improves PSNR across the frozen tokenizers we test. Different code sequences can achieve similar reconstruction quality, leaving room to favour more predictable ones.   We introduce RecaP (Reconstruction and Predictability), which selects codes for a frozen tokenizer by balancing how faithfully they reconstruct the image with how likely their sequence is under a pretrained autoregressive prior. translated_title: 相同的分词器，更好的图像标记：通过MAP（最大后验）推断选择图像标记
translated_abstract: 离散视觉标记对图像进行编码以用于重建，并作为自回归图像生成器的训练目标。向量量化分词器通常独立地为每个编码器特征分配其最近的码字。然而解码器是联合使用这些码字的，因此一个由各自最近码字组成的序列在重建图像时，其保真度可能不如另一种分配方式。对重建损失进行局部建模会产生一个带有依赖于解码器的目标和度量的最近向量问题。在我们测试的所有冻结分词器上，仅基于重建的搜索都提高了PSNR。不同的码字序列可以达到相似的重建质量，这为选择更可预测的序列留下了空间。我们提出RecaP（Reconstruction and Predictability，重建与可预测性），它通过平衡码字序列重建图像的保真度与该序列在预训练自回归先验下的可能性，为冻结的分词器选择码字。在ImageNet上，LlamaGen GPT-B训练……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RecaP方法，通过MAP推断在冻结分词器上同时平衡重建保真度与预训练自回归先验下的序列可预测性，从而为编码器特征选择比独立最近邻更优的图像码字。
